decision.risk_area: security-sensitive code (CSP nonce handling in secure-headers)
decision.why: Three independent bugs in different files; the CSP fix touches security-sensitive code, which sets the floor at deep. Repo has 138 test files, so no safety-net bump. Deep's default effort is medium.
decision.shared:
Run the relevant tests with: npx vitest --run <test file paths>
Do not commit.

parts.title: Case-insensitive Content-Type media types in parseBody() and validator()
parts.text:
`parseBody()` and `validator()` match Content-Type media types case-sensitively.
A request with `Content-Type: Application/JSON` or
`Application/X-WWW-Form-Urlencoded` is parsed fine by the platform Request,
but Hono's checks skip it and pass an empty object downstream. Media types are
case-insensitive (RFC 9110), so these requests should be parsed and validated
like their lower-case equivalents.
parts.why: Small fix in a known pattern, but it needs to find every media-type comparison in the body parsing and validator paths. Not a risk-floor area; tests exist, so no bump.

parts.title: Pass 206 Partial Content responses through the compress middleware uncompressed
parts.text:
The compress middleware gzips 206 Partial Content responses. The
Content-Range header still describes the uncompressed byte range, and the
original Content-Length is dropped, so clients that stitch ranges together
get corrupted data. A 206 response should be passed through uncompressed.
parts.why: One-file behavior change with a clear reproduction; needs a judgment about skipping compression by status. Tests exist, so no bump.

parts.title: Let contentSecurityPolicy and contentSecurityPolicyReportOnly nonces work together
parts.text:
In the secure-headers middleware, using a nonce in one CSP mode breaks when
both `contentSecurityPolicy` and `contentSecurityPolicyReportOnly` are set:
for example a static enforced policy plus a report-only policy that uses a
nonce. The request ends in a 500 response. Each policy should work
independently, including when both use nonces.
parts.risk_area: security-sensitive code (CSP nonce handling in secure-headers)
parts.why: Changes CSP header generation, which is security-sensitive and hard to verify by eye. Risk floor forces deep; medium is its default effort.
